summary: No installer-side threat identified in camelotlabs-sdk@0.0.0-stage
details: Package camelotlabs-sdk at version 0.0.0-stage contains two files with no behaviors indicative of a supply-chain attack. No install-time or import-time network fetch-and-execute, no credential or environment harvesting, no silent-relay of caller data to a hardcoded destination, no backdoor or persistence mechanism, and no dependency-chain dropper structure is present. The version string and minimal content are consistent with a staging or placeholder publish.
